title.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

description.zh:
1931 年九一八事变至 1945 年日本签署投降书，中国人民进行了长达十四年的抗日战争。本专题以日军进攻、中国抗战力量与盟军三条主线，呈现从东北沦陷、全面抗战爆发、战略相持到最终胜利的时空脉络。

> 示意初稿，待史料校订：路线为示意简化，部分事件日期取通行说法，地点坐标为近似值。
description.en:
From the Mukden Incident in September 1931 to Japan’s formal surrender in September 1945, China fought a fourteen-year war of resistance. This atlas follows three threads—the Japanese advance, China’s resistance forces, and the Allied forces—from the fall of the Northeast and the outbreak of full-scale war to protracted resistance and final victory.

> Illustrative draft pending historical review: routes are simplified, some event dates follow conventional accounts, and coordinates are approximate.

description.zh: 自 1931 年九一八事变起，日本关东军及后续侵华部队在中国东北、华北、华中、华南的进攻方向，路线为示意简化。
description.en: Advance directions of the Japanese Kwantung Army and subsequent invasion forces in Northeast, North, Central, and South China from 1931; routes are simplified.

description.zh: 包括正面战场与敌后战场的中国军队、政府机关与民众。路线主要表现抗战初期的抵抗与内迁、以及 1945 年的局部反攻。
description.en: Chinese troops, government organs, and civilians on both the frontal and guerrilla battlefields. Routes show early resistance and relocation, and the limited counteroffensive of 1945.

name.en: Allied Forces and Chinese Expeditionary Force

description.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国与美、英等盟国在中缅印战区协同作战；路线表现中国远征军入缅、撤退与缅北反攻。
description.en: After the Pacific War began, China fought alongside the United States, Britain, and other Allies in the China-Burma-India theater; routes show the Chinese Expeditionary Force’s entry into Burma, retreat, and the northern Burma counteroffensive.
